messages.content: The Friday morning rights meeting has been moved to the Hyatt Regency Chicago. Given my booked room at the Embassy Suites, is it worth changing hotels before the cancellation deadline?

Probably not. The Embassy Suites is roughly a 10-15 minute walk from the Hyatt, so relocating would save only a few minutes that morning. Your other conference activities remain at the Sheraton, and changing the reservation could also mean losing the $248 rate.
So I should just allow extra time Friday and leave the reservation alone?

Yes. Keep the Embassy Suites booking and plan to leave about 20 minutes before the Hyatt meeting. No booking action is warranted. If the meeting location changes again, reassess before the Embassy Suites cancellation cutoff at 6:00 p.m. Chicago time on March 25; after that, the stated penalty is one night.
